<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
To tailor your summary to meet the posting requirement, please provide your exact **number of years of backend engineering experience**. 

**What it costs not to supply this figure:**
Without a specific number of years, your application will almost certainly be screened out immediately by automated Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruiters who filter strictly for the mandatory 8-year threshold. Omitting it prevents us from demonstrating that you meet the baseline requirement, making strong accomplishments (like handling 40,000 orders/day) irrelevant to the initial hiring filter. 

Once you provide your years of experience, I will integrate it into a compelling, requirement-matched rewrite.
